data.title: Compute (SLURM, FSDP, reservation)
data.phase: exclusive-access cleared by Simon 2026-05-26 — wrappers landing
data.summary: SLURM patterns for training on the 4 × H200 Group A reservation; dedicated training reservation request; scheduled-around-serving fallback.

sections.body: The Group A reservation on 98dci4-gpu-0003 (betelgeuse SLURM partition) grants 4 × H200 nodes shared with the V4-Flash production serve. Training has to either preempt the serve (exclusive-access window) or schedule around its idle slots.

Decision 2026-05-20 (S. McIntosh): training runs in exclusive-access mode on the existing gpu_0003_grpA reservation. The maintainer of V4-Flash stops the serve before each training run and restarts after. Locks the serve operator into the loop but avoids a second reservation file.

Proposed name: gpu_0003_grpA_train — same node, same group, separate reservation slot that can be drained without affecting the production serve. Filed as ITER batch-services ticket #4421; pending L. Holzl signoff.

Top risk: ticket #4421 slips past the M1 close window (2026-05-27). Mitigation: continue exclusive-access fallback. Second risk: FSDP across nodes hits the betelgeuse interconnect ceiling at 4 nodes; we expect ~70% scaling — adequate for 500M but tight for v1.

slurm-training-reservation.choice: Both — file but use exclusive in the meantime
slurm-training-reservation.rationale: Filed 2026-05-20; using exclusive while ticket is in queue. Will switch when SDCC responds.

notes.body: Confirmed with L. Holzl that exclusive-pause window is fine for the smoke run; dedicated reservation only matters when curriculum training starts.

followups.title: Stand up exclusive-pause SLURM wrapper script
followups.body: Until SDCC ticket #4421 clears, training runs need a wrapper that stops V4-Flash, claims the node exclusively, runs the job, restarts the serve. Should be a single sbatch template + a 30-line bash prologue. Now actively needed — Simon authorized exclusive access 2026-05-26.
followups.prompt:
Project: imas-ambix
Plan: compute (§2)
Tier: sonnet

Context
  Simon authorized exclusive access on the gpu_0003_grpA reservation 2026-05-26. V4-Flash is not running. Write the canonical SLURM wrapper set for ambix training + bulk-encode + bench jobs.

State to read
  docs/state/imas-ambix/compute.json
  /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-ambix/AGENTS.md  (§2-5 — reservation, account, qos, NUMA, memory budget)

Locked decisions to honour
  slurm-training-reservation → Both — file but use exclusive in the meantime

Constraints
  - sbatch flags: --partition=betelgeuse --reservation=gpu_0003_grpA --account=grpa --gres=gpu:4 --cpus-per-task=30 --mem=640G
  - DO NOT pass --qos (auto-applied; explicit qos errors)
  - export TMPDIR=/scratch_local/$SLURM_JOB_ID && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" in every prologue
  - preempt_v4flash.sh must be idempotent: stop only if running, restart only if it was stopped by this script

Done-when
  1. scripts/slurm/{train_exclusive,bulk_encode_frames,bulk_encode_signals,bench_rbb}.sbatch + preempt_v4flash.sh all committed
  2. Each sbatch is parameterised via --export=ALL,VAR=val and reads JOB_NAME, OUTPUT_DIR, SHOT_SOURCE from env
  3. bulk_encode_frames.sbatch wraps `ambix data bulk-encode-frames --from-quality-index $QUALITY_INDEX --tokenizer open-magvit2 --device cuda --workers 4`
  4. preempt_v4flash.sh dry-runs without ssh — just prints the curl/squeue commands it would issue (V4-Flash is not running)
  5. This followup resolved with the commit SHA + a new followup for first real exclusive-pause run
